Break Point Tennis.name: Break Point Tennis
Break Point Tennis.summary: When the game is on the line, you need blistering service returns, ball hammering ground strokes and an impenetrable net game. You need Break Point Tennis. 8 Adrenaline charged players vie for international supremacy on grass, clay, asphalt and indoor surfaces.

Game no Tetsujin - The Shanghai.name: Game no Tetsujin: The Shanghai
Game no Tetsujin - The Shanghai.summary: Game no Tetsujin: The Shanghai is a Puzzle game, published by SunSoft, which was released in Japan in 1995.

Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo.name: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo
Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo.summary:
The game's title is a parody of Super Street Fighter II Turbo (or Super Street Fighter II X in Japan), as there are no other Puzzle Fighter games, and the game includes music and interface elements spoofing the Street Fighter Alpha and Darkstalkers games. It was a response to SEGA's popular Puyo Puyo 2 that has been sweeping Japanese arcade.

A HD-remake version titled Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo HD Remix, is available for purchase on Microsoft's Xbox Live Arcade and Sony's PlayStation Network.
